name: Huddlespot Community
author: dimadee

sections.description:
Huddlespot lets you add a full-featured community platform to your WordPress site in minutes. It’s built for creators, companies, and organizations who want to bring their audience together in one place — on their own terms.

No shortcodes. No coding. No headaches. Just install, configure a few settings, and you’re up and running.

Why build a community?

  • Talk to your customers directly. Build real relationships instead of shouting into the void.
  • Keep members coming back. People stick around when they form connections with each other.
  • Boost your SEO. User-generated Q&A content is exactly what search engines love.
  • Get honest feedback. Learn what’s working and what’s not, straight from the people who matter.
  • Find your biggest fans. Identify and reward the advocates who champion your brand.
  • One place for everything. Stop juggling Google Groups, Facebook groups, and random forums.

What you get

  • Groups and spaces — public or private, with fine-grained access control
  • Rich user profiles — let members showcase their expertise and contributions
  • Threaded discussions — real-time, multi-level conversations
  • Smart feed — personalized content based on each member’s interests and activity
  • Moderation tools — keep things safe and on-brand
  • Full white-label — your colors, your logo, your domain, your data
  • Admin panel — manage members, roles, badges, and permissions from one place

Who it’s for

Teams and organizations — Give employees a space to collaborate across departments and time zones, without the noise of chat tools.

Creators and brands — Stop renting space on social platforms. Own your audience, your data, and your experience.

Product teams — Gather feedback, crowdsource ideas, and build a living knowledge base around your product.

How it compares

If you’ve tried bbPress or BuddyPress, you know the setup can be painful. Huddlespot is a modern alternative — easier to install, easier to customize, and designed to look great out of the box.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

Huddlespot

The plugin communicates with Huddlespot to power the community platform embedded on your site.

  • Community interface is loaded from https://app.huddlespot.io via a JavaScript SDK
  • API calls are made to https://app.huddlespot.io/api/v1/ for settings, user synchronization, and community management
  • Sitemap data is fetched from https://huddlespot.io for SEO purposes

A Huddlespot account and community ID are required. Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Sentry

The plugin uses Sentry for error reporting and monitoring. Only error and exception details are transmitted to help diagnose issues — no personal user data is intentionally sent.

Sentry Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Huddlespot > Settings and fill in the required fields
  3. That’s it — your community is live
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

Nope. Everything is point-and-click.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. Huddlespot looks great on phones, tablets, and desktops.

How do I get help?

Visit our support community or email us at support@huddlespot.io.
